To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

criminal justice actors use expertise in problem solving justice to intervene within existing criminal justice structures in order to provide more humane and effective interventions for people who sell sex and other vulnerable people.
the use of trauma as a tool for diversion is a form of expertise that is being developed and used by criminal justice actors.
criminal justice actors use the tools at their disposals in order to further personal and organizational goals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which expertise is used to shape and reshape social relations
the ways in which expertise is used in criminal justice to shape the kinds of interventions that are available to women who sell sex.
how expertise is mobilized to address problems that have been defined by criminal justice personnel as problems of criminal justice.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of expertise in criminal justice systems is not a panacea, but it can be used in the service of good and to reduce harm. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2020 APA, all rights reserved)
expertise is not a panacea for social ills.
the use of trauma expertise in criminal justice is a double edged sword.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are interested in the ways in which criminal justice actors use their authority in response to social problems.
we are interested in how criminal justice actors, in the face of the inadequacy and injustice of criminal justice, use their expertise to create a better system of intervention and justice.
expertise in trauma is not the solution to the harms of the sex trade, but it may be the solution to the harm that criminal justice does to women who sell sex.
The main takeaway from our work is that
expertise is not a neutral concept and that the way in which it is used in the context of criminal justice is a political and moral act.
the criminal justice system is not a neutral space. It is not a site of objectivity.
the concept of trauma is used by actors to justify their interventions.
